mods.title: OURPLE GUY: PARKER PACK
mods.description: DISCLAIMER: This mod is intended for those who have played, or are familiar with, Vs. OURPLE GUY. We highly recommend you give it a shot before playing OURPLE GUY: PARKER PACK.As the story goes, a pair of lovers, Brooke and Grace, began to spend time in an old childhood establishment of the latter. In the process, they end up stumbling onto a plethora of unique and expansive worlds contained inside of arcade machines. A series of strange and unexplainable events follows, leading both of them to reopen many old wounds as they struggle to cope with new ones.Now, what if I told you there was another version of this story? What if there was a much cooler, dangerous, handsome man that came before them? What if this man's one goal was to completely and utterly kick the crap out of anything and everything in his path, putting a complete stop to the horrors our original protagtonists would've been subjected to otherwise?Well, I would be lying, because this story, and this man, does not exist.Anyways, here's what it would look like if Parker was the protagonist of Vs.
